review.gallery: Nine native developer images from the 37-page brochure linked by the official Belmore marketing page. The brochure uses Belmore on the cover and also retains some Belgrove wording and designs. The Belmore selection opens on its own boulevard view from page 9.
review.location: Belmore-branded developer map and independent published point match the location identified in historical Belgrove material. Both protected pages remain and their original named map sets are linked. A registered-name relationship was not independently established. The official map’s Metro remains proposed.
review.floorPlans: Eighteen complete Belmore drawings visually reviewed: eight residential, four retail, three typical plates and three amenities plans. Preserved the 1,262.28 printed total with the 0.01 sq ft component difference explained.

unavailable: Contracted unit-specific drawings, current visitor access, written confirmation of the registered-name relationship to Belgrove and an operating Metro station at the proposed location.
